faqs.question: What does the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Pus test measure?
faqs.answer: The test is used to identify fungal infections in the pus sample provided and determine the appropriate antifungal treatment.

faqs.question: Why is the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Pus test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose fungal infections in patients with symptoms such as persistent fever, skin rashes, or respiratory issues • To monitor the effectiveness of antifungal treatment • To guide clinicians in selecting appropriate antifungal medications • To identify rare or emerging fungal species that may require special treatment

faqs.question: When is the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Pus test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: Your doctor might recommend this test if you have • Symptoms suggestive of a fungal infection, such as persistent fever, cough, skin rashes, or nail abnormalities. • A history of recurrent or chronic fungal infections. • A compromised immune system due to conditions like HIV, cancer, or organ transplantation. • Recently travelled to areas with a high prevalence of fungal infections.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Pus test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate a fungal infection that requires treatment.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Pus test?
faqs.answer: You will need to provide a sample of pus in a sterile, leak-proof container. The sample will be sent to the laboratory for processing, including culturing on a fungal culture medium.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Pus test?
faqs.answer: • Ensure that the specimen type, site, clinical history, and clinician contact number are properly mentioned on the test request form. • Collect 2 ml of pus in a sterile leak-proof container. • Follow any additional instructions provided by your doctor regarding fasting or medication use. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Pus test?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside this test include • Blood tests to assess overall health and immune function. • Imaging tests, such as X-rays or CT scans, to evaluate the extent of the infection. • Antifungal susceptibility testing to determine which antifungal medications would work best against the identified fungi.

faqs.question: What is the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Pus test also known as?
faqs.answer: Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF-MS (Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionisation-Time of Flight Mass Spectrometry) Pus.

faqs.question: What is a fungal infection?
faqs.answer: A fungal infection is a condition caused by the overgrowth of fungi in or on the body. Common types of fungal infections include athlete's foot, yeast infections, and ringworm.
